title: friction_rank.py drops 'worked as documented' confirmations and dates reports by session start
problem: Runs now record confirmations ('add_repo + one clone worked first time, as documented; no friction') as doc_friction entries. NO_FRICTION only matches entries that start with 'none/no friction', so these clustered into the top live row and sent process runs to re-read a section that was working. Reports were also dated by session end, though a session reads the docs at its start.
evidence: 2026-11-25, `friction_rank.py --live --ungated --days 3 --no-fetch --no-prs`: #1 was .github/prompts/cloud-session.md at 22 sessions; about half its reports were confirmations, and its three real ones (private-repo migration numbers) were buried
2026-11-25: 28 doc_friction entries across prompts/runs/ match is_confirmation; none of the 28 read as friction on a manual pass

2026-11-25: the top two prompts/ventures/prompt-1.md and bets.md clusters were fixed on main by PR #18882 and PR #18936 but stayed live because the fixes edited docs, which --live does not count; settled with friction_verdicts.json
change: is_confirmation() filters praise-only entries before clustering (any caveat word keeps the entry); load() prefers `started` over `ended`; three verdicts recorded; cloud-session.md step 4 says to renumber migrations before merging.
metric: Share of the top 10 `friction_rank.py --live --ungated --days 3` clusters whose example entry is a confirmation or already fixed on main
baseline: 2026-11-25 before this PR: 3 of the top 4 (cloud-session.md confirmations, ventures/prompt-1.md clone refusal, ventures/prompt-1.md saturation)
source: process run 2026-11-25 (critique: friction_rank top clusters read against main)
result: partial (2026-11-26): the 'worked as documented' entries were gone, but the top live cluster was still cloud-session.md at 19 sessions, 18 of them entries saying the doc was right ('the doc already says to skip register_repo_root, which worked') that P082's caveat list kept because they say 'isn't'/'still'/'not' about add_repo's own text. Follow-up in the same file: AFFIRMS (doc-was-right phrasing) counts as a confirmation unless a complaint word appears; 29 more of 11,030 entries in prompts/runs/ now drop, the register_repo_root row left the live list (verdict re-recorded), and none of the new top 10 examples is a confirmation (read by hand).

history.note: Shipped. The started-time change hid no extra clusters on the 3- and 7-day windows (43 and 80 hidden, same as before), so its value is correctness, not count. Verify by re-reading the top 10 in a few days.

Verified and extended: AFFIRMS/COMPLAINT in friction_rank.py, tests in test_friction_rank.py, register_repo_root verdict re-recorded, two CLAUDE.md clusters (reset --hard, foreground sleep) fixed with one line each.
